message.content:
The U.S. **Declaration of Independence** was formally **adopted by the Continental Congress on July 4, 1776**.  
However, the actual signing ceremony—when the delegates affixed their signatures to the document—took place **later, on August 2, 1776**.  

So:

| Event | Date |
|-------|------|
| Adoption (official approval) | July 4, 1776 |
| Signing ceremony | August 2, 1776 |

(If you’re referring to another country’s declaration, let me know which one!
